opening.argument: The speaker presents himself as a OneCoin leader and promotes participation through a network-marketing structure, including people who have never done network marketing. He then links that recruitment pitch to a sweeping promise of money creation, declaring, "Now WANCOIN we are ourselves the miners of money!" His direct endorsement, "I assure you and join us because it is so incredible," urges viewers to enter the opportunity, while the emphasis on bringing people into the network ties team growth and duplication to the promised benefit. This is a first-person recruitment promotion, not an independent report or an ordinary operational tutorial.
